cd expo && find . -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.ts" | grep -v node_modules | grep -v '.d.ts' | while read f; do
  first_char=$(head -c 1 "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  # Valid TS files start with: / (comment), i (import), e (export), c (const), ' (string), " (string), { (JSON), u (using), t (type), [ (comment block), # (shebang - rare)
  # Base64 starts with letters A-Z a-z but L is common. Check if file has NO newlines and is very long line
  lines=$(wc -l < "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$lines" -le 1 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    size=$(wc -c < "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$size" -gt 500 ] 2>/dev/null; then
      # Check if it's base64 by trying to decode
      if base64 -d "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "BASE64: $f (size=$size, lines=$lines)"
      fi
    fi
  fi
done 2>/dev/null | head -30
